hints: A range may receive an assignment or an addition, and queries ask for its sum.
Use a lazy segment tree that stores each segment sum and pending transformations.
Compose pending tags in order: assignment replaces old values; addition adjusts an assignment if one is pending, otherwise accumulates.
analogy: Delay updates on a whole interval until a later operation needs its children.
example: Assign [2,4] to 5 then add 3 there: all three values become 8, sum 24.
algorithm: Build a lazy segment tree with sum plus optional assignment and addition tags. Push tags before partial descent; apply range set/add in O(log n), and combine child sums.
correctness: Each lazy tag records exactly the transformation owed to every leaf in its interval; correct composition preserves the result of applying updates in order.
complexity: O(log n) per update/query and O(n) space.
